description: This file defines data structures, functions, and logic for performing and aggregating security policy checks on Kubernetes pods, including check definitions, results, and utility functions for managing checks.

classes.name: Check
classes.description: Represents a security policy check with associated metadata and applicable versions.

classes.name: VersionedCheck
classes.description: Defines a specific version of a check, including minimum version and override IDs.

classes.name: CheckResult
classes.description: Contains the outcome of a check, indicating if a pod is allowed and reasons if not.

classes.name: AggregateCheckResult
classes.description: Aggregates multiple check results into a combined outcome with reasons and details.

methods.name: ForbiddenReason
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of all forbidden reasons from the aggregate result.

methods.name: ForbiddenDetail
methods.description: Returns a detailed string of forbidden reasons with optional specific details.

methods.name: AggregateCheckResults
methods.description: Aggregates multiple CheckResult objects into a single result, combining reasons and details.

methods.name: addCheck
methods.description: Adds a check function to either default or experimental check lists based on version info.

methods.name: DefaultChecks
methods.description: Returns a list of checks that are enabled by default.

methods.name: ExperimentalChecks
methods.description: Returns a list of checks that are not yet assigned to policy versions.
